description: Channel worker agents are provider-agnostic; spawn inherits the host agent's runtime
changelog:
**Enhancements:**
- `memerig channel spawn` / `memerig channel run` now default the worker runtime to the host agent's: a Codex session spawns Codex workers, a Claude Code session spawns Claude workers. Precedence is `--provider` > `MEMERIG_CHANNEL_PROVIDER` > host env markers > `MEMERIG_PLATFORM` > the repository's single configured worker platform > legacy frontmatter `provider:`.
- `memerig init` pre-checks Codex only; Claude Code, Cursor and the rest stay opt-in.
- `.memerig/spec/` starts empty apart from a README that explains the layout.
notes: Existing agent files that still carry `provider:` keep working as a last-resort fallback. Run `memerig update` to pick up the new agent templates.
